title: galium trifidum subsp. pacificum
intro: Galium trifidum subsp. pacificum, commonly known as Pacific bedstraw, is a plant species within the Rubiaceae family. Pacific bedstraw has been traditionally used in herbal medicine for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its ability to modulate immune responses, reduce oxidative stress, and exhibit antimicrobial activity. Pacific bedstraw contains bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
